analysis: Examined the modified ProviderLoop.swift (head lines 1-1205) and the DaemonState+Coding.swift patch. Changes in ProviderLoop.swift are limited to new actor stored state: selectedModelRecovery (719-721), selectedModelRecoveryLoadOverride (722-723, nil in production test seam), savedEnabledModels (726), enabledModelsAtLastSwitch (730), plus the init assignment at line 882 from config.config.backend.enabledModels. These are in-memory bookkeeping fields. This diff adds no network-facing, crypto, attestation, authorization or cache-storage logic. Nothing touches the coordinator WebSocket contract (TB-002), App Attest serving authorization (TB-011), the prefix cache (T-041), or key material (A-002/A-003). DaemonState+Coding.swift adds Codable keys for enabledModelsAtStart, enabledModelsAtLastSwitch and selectedModelRecovery, all decoded with decodeIfPresent and encoded with encodeIfPresent, so older state files still decode. The added data is operator-configured model-ID lists and recovery entries, not prompts, keys, tokens or attestation blobs, so no A-001 exposure is introduced. The state file is local and already carries model lists (advertisedModels, servingSelection). Remaining questions the next pass should check outside the supplied evidence: (1) the SelectedModelRecoveryEntry struct definition and what fields it serializes, since the unit only shows the coding keys, so no secret or prompt-derived fields should be added; (2) ProviderLoop+SelectedModelRecovery.swift, which implements the new recovery load path, to confirm it respects admission, drain, add-on hold (TB-012/T-059), memory-gate and self-test paths, and does not bypass weight-hash verification (T-027/T-012) when reloading a model; (3) the DaemonState struct's own declaration, with the file's permissions, for the new fields. These are unverified contracts, not demonstrated regressions. The patch excerpt for the coding file is marked incomplete, but the visible hunks are consistent additions.
